The '''Introduction''' section of {{origins}} is an introduction to the purpose and structure of the book.

==Dedication==

The first section of the book also contains the following dedication:

{{quote|To Robert Jordan

For his Heart,

For his Light,

Forever.}}

==Foreword==

Following the dedication is a foreword by [[Harriet McDougal]] explaining the origins of {{origins}}.

==Letter to readers==

After Harriet's foreword is a letter addressed to the readers by the author, [[Michael Livingston]].
